mapper.select: SELECT sc.*, CONCAT_WS(' ', CASE ts_old.day_of_week WHEN 1 THEN '周一' WHEN 2 THEN '周二' WHEN 3 THEN '周三' WHEN 4 THEN '周四' WHEN 5 THEN '周五' WHEN 6 THEN '周六' WHEN 7 THEN '周日' END, ts_old.slot_name ) as old_time_slot_info, CONCAT_WS(' ', CASE ts_new.day_of_week WHEN 1 THEN '周一' WHEN 2 THEN '周二' WHEN 3 THEN '周三' WHEN 4 THEN '周四' WHEN 5 THEN '周五' WHEN 6 THEN '周六' WHEN 7 THEN '周日' END, ts_new.slot_name ) as new_time_slot_info, u.real_name as operator_name, ut.real_name as new_teacher_name FROM schedule_change sc LEFT JOIN time_slot ts_old ON sc.old_time_slot_id = ts_old.id LEFT JOIN time_slot ts_new ON sc.new_time_slot_id = ts_new.id LEFT JOIN user u ON sc.operator_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user ut ON sc.new_teacher_id = ut.id ORDER BY sc.create_time DESC
SELECT sc.*, u.real_name as operator_name FROM schedule_change sc LEFT JOIN user u ON sc.operator_id = u.id WHERE sc.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY sc.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_change (schedule_id, old_time_slot_id, new_time_slot_id, new_teacher_id, change_type, change_reason, operator_id) VALUES (#{scheduleId}, #{oldTimeSlotId}, #{newTimeSlotId}, #{newTeacherId}, #{changeType}, #{changeReason}, #{operatorId})
